newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Greek Cypriot soldier wounds self in shooting.
newsitem.headline: Greek Cypriot soldier wounds self in shooting.

text.p: A Greek Cypriot soldier shot and wounded himself on Saturday in a post near the ceasefire line dividing the island, Cypriot officials said.
"The wound was self inflicted," defence ministry spokesman Andreas Charides told Reuters. "It was a single shot and it is not serious."

The soldier was found by other soldiers at 5.20 a.m. (0220 GMT) at Avgorou village in southeastern Cyprus. Two weeks ago a Greek Cypriot from Avgorou was fatally shot by Turkish forces after he wandered across the buffer zone looking for snails.
Cyprus has been split between Turkish Cypriots and Greek Cypriots since 1974, when Turkish troops invaded after a coup on the island backed by the military regime then ruling Athens.
